relationship: Cross-layer theme: functions and state → simulation and reasoning → decision delivery. The existing causal theme stays intact.
interpretation: Repository classification, not a universal definition, evidence ranking or endorsement. Profile rows are not additional studies.

axis_definitions.theme_role: Author-described twin, conceptual framework, method enabler or synthetic-data analogue. No automatic equivalence.
axis_definitions.application: Scientific application; independent of study design and causal claims.
axis_definitions.entity: What is represented: an organ, person, subpopulation, synthetic cohort or concept.
axis_definitions.wearable_relation: Actual sensing relationship. A wearable-oriented title does not prove wrist acquisition.
axis_definitions.personalization: Person-specific fitting, group conditioning and external-stream/anatomy pairing are separate.
axis_definitions.update_mode: Distinguishes state refresh, parameter retraining, offline streaming and offline calibration. Cadence is in time_scope.
axis_definitions.simulation_kind: Factual reconstruction, input editing, mechanistic replay, effect estimation and synthetic data have different semantics.
axis_definitions.execution: Where decisions stop: simulation, human advice, patient support or actuation. This is not evidence of safety.
axis_definitions.evaluation: Multiple non-ordinal evaluation designs may apply. Trial-data replay is distinct from prospective randomization.
axis_definitions.causal_status: Curated limit of causal interpretation; mechanistic structure alone does not prove causal identification.
axis_definitions.review_scope: Sections actually checked in this pass, or explicitly preserved earlier annotations.
